ns0:svg.ns0:title: J4 — Conn_01x04 (illustrated: pin_header_1x04_p2_54)
Unshrouded 1x4 pin header, 2.54 mm pitch
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Single-row unshrouded male header with four square posts on a 2.54 mm grid. Flat top-down Bouni-style vector artwork. Board pads and copper remain native.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: J5 — USB_B_Mini (illustrated: usb_micro_b_105017)
Micro-USB-B receptacle, Molex 105017 family
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Top-down surface view of a horizontal Micro-USB-B receptacle with its shield profile and five signal contacts. Flat top-down Bouni-style vector artwork. Board pads and copper remain native.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: J2 — Conn_01x10 (illustrated: pin_header_1x10_p2_54)
Unshrouded 1x10 pin header, 2.54 mm pitch
